report:
Reviewed the complete claim and all entries: ordinary sage_meta::book implementation in book.rs and sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::self_contained_book_explorer. Independently verified book.rs and spec_plan.rs are exact byte matches to the supplied historical snapshots; the historical assessment remains consistent with the current claim and evidence.

Source assessment: preprocess invokes generate_crates for the Crates chapter; generation reloads model documents, builds crate/module chapters, invokes render_book_browser and writes the explorer asset whenever its output differs. chapter embeds explorer_frame, whose depth-relative URLs and encoded routes provide both an iframe and a full-page link to the same asset. This establishes the book integration and snapshot regeneration wiring, not the renderer's complete runtime behavior. The captured handwritten Crates landing page links directly to .sage modules and crate subchapters as required. Searchable/interlinked presentation, model and Rust-source snapshot contents, shared local/book renderer behavior, server-independent published browsing including Rust source, and effective refresh after model/source edits remain browser-integration obligations covered by the explicit deferral rather than claimed verified here.

The complete associated test body contains only a TODO comment and no assertions. Its prerequisite is building/exercising an embedded and full-page explorer with Rust source, browsing without a Sage server, and rebuilding after changed sources; meaningful integration coverage must then assert search/link navigation, shared delivery, embedded snapshots and freshness. A broken offline Rust pane or stale source snapshot would not be detected by this placeholder. The TODO remains justified and visible; accepting it does not establish implementation completeness or test adequacy for those deferred behaviors. No N/A entries or additional associated tests exist. No edits are requested for this unchanged, explicitly deferred evidence.

Execution: personally ran review start, recorded dependency reads, baseline byte comparison and review record; no behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator-reported 321 passing functional tests and successful root build are separate execution context, not proof from this placeholder or commands personally executed.
